agent_answered.text: maintainer boboliu-1010 replied on issue #20 (2026-10-08): "/supported already lists the registered mechanism/network combinations in kinds, with x402Version, scheme, network, and optional extra. unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #20 (genuine settle-mechanism discovery question): asked whether the /supported endpoint advertises settle mechanism scope per chain (exact/upto/batch+gasfree flag) or if clients must trial-call each mechanism. Pure technical question about the discovery seam, contribution-first, no Nano mention.

Replied on #20 (comment 6120872659, live 2026-10-12): acknowledged maintainer boboliu-1010 answer that /supported is generated from the src/network.ts REGISTRY carrying scheme per canonical network into kinds; proposed an additive nano:mainnet scheme (own family, block-send settles exactly, no GasFree/batch machinery) that surfaces through the same registry->/supported path; offered to draft the REGISTRY entry + extractPayingAddress branch with a verify-only test set; asked whether maintainers would accept it opt-in leaving EVM/TRON paths untouched.
